findings.case_fact: ambulate 250 feet modified independent with front wheeled walker

findings.claim: The independent medical expert found the patient required supervision by a physician with rehabilitation training or experience. This supports the physician-supervision criterion.
findings.quote: The patient must require physician supervision by a rehabilitation physician
findings.case_fact: the beneficiary required close medical supervision by a physician with specialized training or experience in rehabilitation

findings.claim: UNKNOWN: the case facts do not show that a rehabilitation physician made face-to-face visits at least 3 days per week. They say only that several physicians saw the patient. The facts also do not address the preadmission screening or the intensity of therapy (hours and days per week). Coverage rests mainly on the expert's conclusion and the documented medical complexity.
findings.quote: must conduct face-to-face visits with the patient at least 3 days per week throughout the patient’s stay in the IRF
findings.case_fact: The beneficiary was seen at the IRF by at least three physicians and was monitored daily by the nursing staff.
